message.content: {"note_claim": "The photo shows unidentified guests bowing at an event years before the British Royal family visited Ethiopia, not Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The two individuals bowing before the Ethiopian emperor and empress are not identified, but they could not be Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip, as their first visit to Ethiopia did not happen for another ten years.", "reason": "The Reuters fact check directly confirms that the photo depicts unidentified guests bowing in 1955, ten years before the British royal visit to Ethiopia."}

parsed.note_claim: The photo shows unidentified guests bowing at an event years before the British Royal family visited Ethiopia, not Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The two individuals bowing before the Ethiopian emperor and empress are not identified, but they could not be Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip, as their first visit to Ethiopia did not happen for another ten years.
parsed.reason: The Reuters fact check directly confirms that the photo depicts unidentified guests bowing in 1955, ten years before the British royal visit to Ethiopia.
